messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — Quick flag on HelixCorp renewal. Procurement says they need the signature sequence changed: subsidiary CFO signs first, then parent procurement. That causes a vendor-code mismatch with our billing system. :thinking_face:
sam_sales: Ugh — procurement insisting on subsidiary signoff for budget reasons. Do we have a precedent for handling different vendor codes on the same contract?
olivia_finance: We can accept multiple vendor codes but invoicing will split across two POs and require separate invoices. That will increase ops overhead.
raj_support: Heads-up: enablement kickoff is blocked until billing is resolved (they won't confirm dates without a consolidated invoice).
talia_legal: Can we change the signing order in the DocuSign envelope so parent signs first but attach a signed attestation from the subsidiary? That often satisfies procurement without changing vendor code.
maria_cs: Procurement explicitly said 'subsidiary first' — they won't accept attestation. They gave this example: PO 2026-HTX-557 (subsidiary) and PO 2026-HTX-558 (parent).
procurement-bot: New PO uploaded: 2026-HTX-557 (amount: $72,000) — vendor code: HTX-SUB.
sam_sales: If we split invoices, pricing needs to be pro-rated for the mid-quarter seat add-on. Can finance calculate split lines?
olivia_finance: Proposed billing matrix below (will confirm numbers after legal OK):
```
Line 1: Core seats (annual) — Invoice to PO 2026-HTX-558 — $120,000
Line 2: Subsidiary seats (9mo) — Invoice to PO 2026-HTX-557 — $54,000
Line 3: Seat add-on (mid-quarter, pro-rated) — Invoice to PO 2026-HTX-557 — $6,750
Total split invoices: $180,750
```
raj_support: Ok that's workable but please note enablement needs a single invoice PDF for their AP team to release the kickoff funds. Two PDFs may delay by another 5 business days.
talia_legal: Two options: 1) Issue consolidated invoice with dual-PO reference lines (one PDF referencing both vendor codes) — requires legal to add a PO-clause exception, or 2) Proceed with split invoices and offer a one-time onboarding credit to offset delay. Which do we prefer?
maria_cs: Customer prefers fastest onboarding. I vote consolidated PDF with both PO refs. Can legal add the exception?
talia_legal: I can add a one-off PO clause stating invoices may reference multiple internal PO numbers. Need signoff from finance for the consolidated invoice routing.
olivia_finance: I can approve the consolidated invoice workflow if procurement confirms both POs should be referenced on the single invoice and treasury accepts combined wiring instructions. Please get procurement confirmation in writing.
sam_sales: I'll ping the buyer: @HelixProcurement — can you confirm we can issue one invoice PDF that lists both PO 2026-HTX-557 and 2026-HTX-558 and that treasury will accept the parent wiring info? :eyes:
(production silence)
Helix Procurement (quoted): "We can accept one PDF if the supplier references both internal PO numbers and the parent treasury details. Subsidiary still needs to sign first — that won't change."
maria_cs: OK legal will add clause, finance will accept consolidated invoice. Next blocker: DocuSign envelope order still needs subsidiary signature first. Can we structure envelope so subsidiary signs first but system maps both PO refs to the single invoice?
talia_legal: Yes — we'll create a DocuSign flow with signing order: 1) subsidiary CFO, 2) parent procurement, 3) Redwood. We'll include an Annex A listing both PO numbers and a clause about invoice referencing. That should satisfy procurement and finance.
olivia_finance: Confirmed — as long as Annex A is present on the signed PDF, treasury will wire to parent account.
raj_support: Great — I'm unblocking enablement dates. Can we lock in kickoff for next Tuesday 10am?
maria_cs: Tentatively booked. I will update the customer and attach the updated DocuSign link once legal uploads the new envelope.
procurement-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example.com/envelopes/0a1b2c — signing order set.
sam_sales: Thanks — I'll follow up with a short email to buyer with the updated flow and the kickoff hold.
maria_cs: Final action items: Talia to add PO-clause and upload envelope; Olivia to validate invoice PDF template references both POs; Sam to confirm buyer email; Raj to confirm enablement slot after signed PDF received. Everyone ok?
all: :thumbsup:
(END)
